subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is source-level terminal proof plus regression coverage sufficient to merge this classifier-only message-delivery fix, or should the PR wait for a live WhatsApp/OpenRouter-style channel run?
rationale: The code change is narrow and source-backed, but it sits on the terminal message-delivery classifier and the contributor did not prove the full live channel scenario from the report.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Pause until someone posts a redacted live configured-channel transcript or logs showing the post-update_plan final answer is delivered.
